profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary: This summary was generated by a human.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Currently working on Cloud Data Analytics
- Previously: Home Platform, Nest Growth, Play Promotions Platform, Play Music Services

positions.title: Self-employed Guitarist
positions.description: - Recorded and performed professionally in US, Japan, and South Korea.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
- Citygram/CUSP Noise Project
- Supervisor: Professor Tae Hong Park
- Developed DSP units for Android OS for recording, analyzing, processing, and streaming environmental sounds
- Developed Sound Analysis Toolbox, a MATLAB suite, for analysis and automatic classification of large-scale urban audio recordings

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
- Supervisor: Professor Morwaread Farbood
- Created MATLAB scripts to generate random dot kinematogram for audiovisual perception studies
- Administered audiovisual perception experiments

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Prototyped potential products based on the ideas of a collaborating musician BT (Brian Transeau)
- Developed Trash 2, a creative audio distortion plug-in suite

honors.title: Research Assistantship
honors.description: Received full tuition waiver and stipend for the 2013 - 2014 academic year to work on Citygram/CUSP Noise Project
honors.issuer: Issued by NYU Steinhardt Department of Music and Performing Arts Professions · Sep 2013

honors.title: Berklee Achievement-Based Scholarship
honors.description: Received achievement-based scholarship with incremental achievement grants
honors.issuer: Issued by Berklee College of Music · Jan 2010

projects.title: Computer Graphics Projects
projects.description: Explored various computer graphics topics, including fragment/vertex shaders, ray tracing, transformation matrices, and forward/inverse kinematics, and modeled interactive scenes with interesting shapes using WebGL and JavaScript

projects.title: Multi-Domain Language Modeling
projects.description: Devised and compared methods to combine multiple language models in different domains for more robust likelihood estimation with broader domain coverage
